behaviors.behavior: Dynamically-named tests (it(caseName, fn)) are pooled under a shared sentinel identity instead of colliding with each other or being invisible
Duplicate literal test names are pooled, not ordinal-keyed (immune to decoy reordering)
Marks are tracked as a multiset (Counter), so a repeated mark occurrence is only flagged when the occurrence COUNT increases, not merely present
A pooled identity losing one of its instances (instance_count decreases) is reported non-blocking (pooled_test_instance_lost), never silently ignored
A skip/xfail mark gained on a content signature occurring exactly once on both before and after sides is caught (exact-content-key match)
A relocated-mark finding BLOCKS only when the whole pool's content-signature Counter is unchanged (full bijection); otherwise it is only REPORTED, never a false block
